title: site: filter out bot contributors
body: The GitHub contributors API appends `[bot]` to the login of bot users. This caused Dependabot to be linked as https://github.com/dependabot[bot] instead of https://github.com/dependabot in the contributors list. Because normal users cannot have `[bot]` in their name, it can just be removed entirely.
